exercises.instructionEn: First read the sentences and explain the meaning of the words in bold, then listen and underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval gaplarni o'qing va qalin yozilgan so'zlarning ma'nosini tushuntiring, so'ng tinglab, to'g'ri so'zni tanlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda bu yerda audio bor. Javoblarni 4-mashqdagi ikkita e'londan ham topish mumkin — shuning uchun bu mashqni audiosiz ham bajarsa bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashq TINGLASHDAN OLDIN so'zlarni bilib olishga o'rgatadi.
Enterprise'da doim shunday: avval so'zlarni tushunasiz, keyin tinglaysiz.
Shunda audio tushunarli bo'ladi.

Bu yerdagi qarama-qarshi juftlar:
  expensive ↔ cheap   (qimmat ↔ arzon)
  big       ↔ small   (katta ↔ kichik)
  garage    ↔ garden  (garaj ↔ bog') — o'xshash yozilgan, chalkashtirmang!
  balcony   ↔ swimming-pool (balkon ↔ basseyn)

'quite' va 'rather' — 'ancha, birmuncha' ma'nosidagi kuchaytiruvchilar:
  The house is QUITE expensive.  — Uy ancha qimmat.
  The flat is RATHER small.      — Kvartira ancha kichik.

items.whyUz: 4-mashqdagi A matnida: 'It is quite expensive, but it is very large.' Narxi £370,000 — qimmat. expensive = qimmat, cheap = arzon.
A matnida: 'Upstairs, there are three bedrooms.' upstairs = tepa qavatda, downstairs = past qavatda.

items.textEn: The house has also got a beautiful ____ .
items.whyUz: A matnida: 'a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.' garden = bog', garage = garaj. Ikkalasi o'xshash yoziladi, lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.
B matnida: 'It is rather small, but it is in a very pleasant area.'

items.textEn: The flat has got a big ____ .
items.whyUz: B matnida: 'The flat has also got a big balcony with a wonderful view.' Basseyn (swimming-pool) uyda (A matni), kvartirada emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts and explain the words in bold. How many rooms are there in each place? What is there in each room? What else has each place got?
exercises.instructionUz: A matni — SOTILADIGAN uy. Har bir gapni o'qing va tarjimasini ko'ring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN A — gazetadagi ko'chmas mulk e'loni.

  For Sale £370,000
  Address: 11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury

  For Sale — sotiladi
  Address  — manzil
  £        — funt sterling (Britaniya puli)

Manzil yozilishi INGLIZCHA tartibda:
  11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury
  uy raqami, ko'cha nomi, shahar
O'zbekchada ham shunday tartib, lekin ingliz tilida uy raqami
HAR DOIM birinchi keladi va vergul bilan ajratiladi.

Canterbury — Angliyaning janubi-sharqidagi tarixiy shahar.

sentences.noteUz: £370,000 o'qilishi: 'three hundred and seventy thousand pounds'.

sentences.en: This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre, and is near the shops and the main road.
sentences.uz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan yarim mil masofada, do'konlar va katta yo'lga yaqin.
sentences.noteUz: lovely = go'zal, yoqimli. half a mile ≈ 800 metr. 1 mile ≈ 1,6 km.

sentences.en: It is quite expensive, but it is very large.
sentences.uz: U ancha qimmat, lekin juda katta.
sentences.noteUz: quite = ancha, but = lekin, very = juda.

sentences.en: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, each with a wardrobe and a bathroom.
sentences.uz: Tepa qavatda uchta yotoqxona bor, har birida kiyim shkafi va hammom bor.
sentences.noteUz: upstairs = tepa qavatda. each with... = har birida ... bilan.

sentences.en: There is also a study with a big bookcase.
sentences.uz: Yana katta kitob javonli ish xonasi ham bor.
sentences.noteUz: also = ham, yana. 'There is' — birlik, bitta study.

sentences.en: Downstairs, there is a small bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a huge kitchen, a dining-room and a spacious living-room with a fireplace.
sentences.uz: Past qavatda dush va hojatxonali kichik hammom, juda katta oshxona, ovqatlanish xonasi va kaminli keng mehmonxona bor.
sentences.noteUz: downstairs = past qavatda. huge = ulkan (big'dan kuchliroq). spacious = keng, kengaygan.

sentences.en: The house has also got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
sentences.uz: Uyning yana chiroyli bog'i va basseyni bor.
sentences.noteUz: has got = bor (Britan inglizchasi). AQShda 'has' deyiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts and explain the words in bold. How many rooms are there in each place? What is there in each room? What else has each place got?
exercises.instructionUz: B matni — IJARAGA BERILADIGAN kvartira. Har bir gapni o'qing va tarjimasini ko'ring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN B — ijara e'loni.

  For Rent £180/month
  Address: 6, Shell Street, Canterbury

  For Rent — ijaraga beriladi
  /month   — oyiga

SOTIB OLISH ↔ IJARA:
  For Sale — sotiladi (bir marta to'lanadi: £370,000)
  For Rent — ijaraga beriladi (har oy to'lanadi: £180)

UY ↔ KVARTIRA:
  house — uy (alohida bino)
  flat  — kvartira (Britan inglizchasi)
  AQShda 'apartment' deyiladi.

sentences.noteUz: o'qilishi: 'a hundred and eighty pounds a month'.

sentences.en: This attractive flat is in a quiet street near the city centre.
sentences.uz: Bu chiroyli kvartira shahar markaziga yaqin tinch ko'chada joylashgan.
sentences.noteUz: attractive = jozibali, chiroyli. quiet = tinch, jimjit.

sentences.en: It is rather small, but it is in a very pleasant area.
sentences.uz: U ancha kichik, lekin juda yoqimli hududda.
sentences.noteUz: rather = ancha (ko'pincha salbiy soyada). pleasant = yoqimli. area = hudud, mahalla.

sentences.en: It has got a pretty bedroom, a bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a modern kitchen with a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge, and a comfortable living-room.
sentences.uz: Unda chiroyli yotoqxona, dush va hojatxonali hammom, plita, idish yuvish mashinasi va muzlatgichli zamonaviy oshxona hamda qulay mehmonxona bor.
sentences.noteUz: pretty = chiroyli (kichik narsalar uchun). modern = zamonaviy. comfortable = qulay, shinam.

sentences.en: The flat has also got a big balcony with a wonderful view.
sentences.uz: Kvartirada yana ajoyib manzarali katta balkon bor.

sentences.en: There is a large garage behind the building.
sentences.noteUz: large = katta (big bilan bir xil). behind = orqasida. building = bino.

exercises.instructionEn: How many rooms are there in each place? What is there in each room? What else has each place got?
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu savollar matnni TUSHUNGANINGIZNI tekshiradi.

'How many...?' — nechta? Javob RAQAM bo'ladi.
'What else...?' — yana nima? Javob qo'shimcha narsa bo'ladi.

Sanashda faqat XONALARNI sanaymiz: bog', basseyn, balkon, garaj —
bular xona emas, ular 'outside' (tashqarida) hisoblanadi.

items.textEn: A. How many rooms are there in the house?
items.whyUz: Tepada: 3 yotoqxona + hammom + ish xonasi = 5. Pastda: kichik hammom + oshxona + ovqatlanish xonasi + mehmonxona = 4. Jami 9 ta.

items.textEn: A. What has the house got outside?
items.answer: It has got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
items.whyUz: Bog' va basseyn — uyning tashqarisida.

items.textEn: A. What is there in the study?
items.whyUz: 'There is also a study with a big bookcase.'

items.textEn: A. What is there in the living-room?
items.whyUz: 'a spacious living-room with a fireplace'.

items.textEn: B. How many rooms are there in the flat?
items.whyUz: Yotoqxona + hammom + oshxona + mehmonxona = 4 ta.

items.textEn: B. What is there in the kitchen?
items.answer: There is a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge.
items.whyUz: 'a modern kitchen with a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge'.

items.textEn: B. What has the flat got outside?
items.answer: It has got a big balcony and a large garage.
items.whyUz: Balkon va garaj — kvartiraning tashqarisida.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again and make notes under the following headings, then look at the notes and talk about the two places. Type of Home - Location - Cost - Size - Inside the House/Flat (Rooms, Furniture etc) - Outside the House/Flat
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing va sarlavhalar bo'yicha qayd yozing, so'ng qaydlarga qarab ikkala joy haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLISH (making notes) — muhim ko'nikma.
Matnni to'liq yodlamaysiz, faqat KALIT so'zlarni yozib olasiz,
keyin o'sha qaydlarga qarab o'z so'zingiz bilan gapirasiz.

Sarlavhalar:
  Type of Home — uy turi (house / flat)
  Location     — joylashuvi (qayerda?)
  Cost         — narxi (qancha?)
  Size         — hajmi (katta / kichik)
  Inside       — ichkarisi (xonalar, mebel)
  Outside      — tashqarisi (bog', garaj, balkon)

Quyidagi namunalar — to'liq gap holida. Ularni yodlab olsangiz,
istalgan uy haqida gapira olasiz.

notes.heading: Location
notes.a: 11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury — half a mile from the city centre, near the shops and the main road
notes.b: 6, Shell Street, Canterbury — a quiet street near the city centre, a very pleasant area

notes.heading: Cost
notes.b: For Rent, £180 a month — very cheap

notes.heading: Inside
notes.a: upstairs: three bedrooms (each with a wardrobe), a bathroom, a study with a big bookcase; downstairs: a small bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a huge kitchen, a dining-room, a spacious living-room with a fireplace
notes.b: a pretty bedroom, a bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a modern kitchen with a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge, a comfortable living-room

notes.heading: Outside
notes.a: a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool
notes.b: a big balcony with a wonderful view, a large garage behind the building

modelAnswers: The first place is a house.
It is at 11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury, half a mile from the city centre.
It is for sale and it costs £370,000, so it is quite expensive.
Upstairs there are three bedrooms, each with a wardrobe, a bathroom and a study with a big bookcase.
Downstairs there is a small bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a huge kitchen, a dining-room and a spacious living-room with a fireplace.
Outside, the house has got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
The second place is a flat.
It is at 6, Shell Street, Canterbury, in a quiet street near the city centre.
It is for rent and it costs £180 a month, so it is very cheap.
It is rather small, but it is in a very pleasant area.
Inside, there is a pretty bedroom, a bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a modern kitchen with a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge, and a comfortable living-room.
Outside, the flat has got a big balcony with a wonderful view and a large garage behind the building.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the adjectives in bold in the texts in Ex. 4 and fill in the nouns which are used with them.
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashq matnlaridagi qalin sifatlarga qarang va ular bilan ishlatilgan otlarni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT + OT birikmalari (collocations).

Ingliz tilida ba'zi sifatlar ma'lum otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
Masalan 'pretty' — kichik, nozik narsalar uchun: a pretty bedroom.
'Huge' esa juda katta narsalar uchun: a huge kitchen.

So'zni ALOHIDA emas, BIRIKMA holida yodlang — shunda tabiiy gapirasiz:
  ❌ 'beautiful' = chiroyli
  ✅ 'a beautiful garden' = chiroyli bog'

Matn A dan: lovely house, huge kitchen, spacious living-room,
            beautiful garden
Matn B dan: attractive flat, quiet street, pleasant area,
            pretty bedroom, modern kitchen, comfortable living-room,
            wonderful view, large garage

items.whyUz: Namuna: 'This lovely house...' (A matni)
A matni: 'a huge kitchen'. huge = ulkan.
A matni: 'a spacious living-room with a fireplace'. spacious = keng.
A matni: 'a beautiful garden'.
B matni: 'This attractive flat...'.
B matni: 'in a quiet street'. quiet = tinch.
B matni: 'a very pleasant area'. area = hudud.
B matni: 'a pretty bedroom'.
B matni: 'a modern kitchen'. modern = zamonaviy.
B matni: 'a comfortable living-room'. comfortable = qulay.
B matni: 'a wonderful view'. view = manzara.
B matni: 'a large garage behind the building'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the adjectives which have a similar meaning. Choose adjectives from the list above.
exercises.instructionUz: Yaqin ma'noli sifatlarni yozing. Yuqoridagi ro'yxatdan tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIMLAR — bir xil ma'noli so'zlar.

Kitobda birinchi harf va harflar soni berilgan:
  big       = huge, s________, l_____
  beautiful = attractive, p______
  pleasant  = l______, w_________

Nega bir necha so'z kerak? Chunki bir so'zni takrorlab yozish
zerikarli. Yozma ishda sinonim ishlatish — yuqori daraja belgisi.

Ottenkalar:
  big      — oddiy 'katta'
  huge     — juda katta, ulkan
  large    — katta (big bilan deyarli bir xil, rasmiyroq)
  spacious — keng, joyi ko'p (xona uchun)

  beautiful  — go'zal (kuchli maqtov)
  attractive — jozibali
  pretty     — chiroyli (kichik narsalar uchun)

  pleasant  — yoqimli
  lovely    — yoqimli, shirin (og'zaki nutqda ko'p)
  wonderful — ajoyib (juda kuchli)

items.whyUz: s bilan boshlanadi, 8 harf: spacious = keng.
l bilan boshlanadi, 5 harf: large = katta.
p bilan boshlanadi, 6 harf: pretty = chiroyli.
l bilan boshlanadi, 6 harf: lovely = yoqimli.
w bilan boshlanadi, 9 harf: wonderful = ajoyib.

groups.explanationUz: Fe'l yoki otga -ive qo'shilib sifat yasaladi. Ma'nosi: 'shu xususiyatga ega'.
Otga -ful qo'shilsa 'shunga to'la' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi. DIQQAT: bitta 'l' bilan yoziladi!
Uy tavsifida doim juft bo'lib keladi.
Fe'l va ot bir xil yoziladi, lekin gapda vazifasi boshqa.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Uy va kvartira tavsifi uchun kerakli tuzilmalar.

patterns.formula: The house/flat HAS GOT + a/an + narsa.
patterns.exampleEn: The house has also got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
patterns.exampleUz: Uyning yana chiroyli bog'i va basseyni bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'have got / has got' — egalikni bildiradi (Britan inglizchasi).
  I/you/we/they HAVE GOT
  he/she/it     HAS GOT
Uy va kvartira — 'it', shuning uchun HAS GOT.

patterns.exampleEn: It is quite expensive, but it is very large.
patterns.exampleUz: U ancha qimmat, lekin juda katta.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kuchaytiruvchilar:
  quite  — ancha (o'rtacha)
  rather — ancha (ko'pincha salbiy: 'rather small' — kichikroq ekan)
  very   — juda (eng kuchli)

patterns.exampleEn: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms. Downstairs, there is a huge kitchen.
patterns.exampleUz: Tepa qavatda uchta yotoqxona bor. Past qavatda ulkan oshxona bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Joy so'zi gap BOSHIDA turishi mumkin, keyin vergul qo'yiladi.
Bu tavsifni tartibli qiladi: avval tepa, keyin past.

patterns.exampleEn: a bathroom with a shower and a toilet
patterns.explanationUz:
'with' — 'bilan, ...li'. Xona ichida nima borligini qisqa aytadi.
O'zbekchada '-li' qo'shimchasi: kaminli, dushli, javonli.

patterns.exampleEn: This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan yarim mil masofada.
patterns.explanationUz:
Masofa uchun FROM. Yaqinlik uchun NEAR:
  near the shops = do'konlarga yaqin (from yo'q!)
